result.topic_en: Riemann discusses the transformation-theoretic definition and properties of the integer-valued symbol (m,n) arising from the transformation of log eta as the variable omega approaches the rational value m/n (Dedekind-sum-like reciprocity), and begins setting up the limit omega near m/n.
